doc_title_en: Notice of Upward Revision of Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
doc_title_jp: 連結業績予想の上方修正及び配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 連結業績の上方修正と配当性向50%以上とする基本方針

summary_en: SKY Perfect JSAT raised its full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 by 4 yen per share to 52 yen, comprising an interim dividend of 24 yen and a year-end dividend of 28 yen, reflecting upward revisions to consolidated earnings forecasts.
summary_jp: 2027年3月期の年間配当予想を1株当たり4円増配し52円に修正。第2四半期末24円、期末28円。連結業績予想の上方修正と配当性向50%以上の基本方針に基づくもの。
